notes: All summary/label text is original functional paraphrase, not game prose.

verified=true means every mechanical fact in the entry is confirmed by sts_lightspeed GameContext.cpp; verified=false means some fields rely on spire-archive/wiki and are listed in needsJarVerification.
rounding on pct amounts: floor|round|ceil, matching lightspeed fractionMaxHp modes (default floor).
loseHp kind: 'damage' = lightspeed damagePlayer (interacts with damage modifiers e.g. Intangible/Tungsten Rod semantics differ), 'hpLoss' = playerLoseHp.
randomRelicTier roll (relicRng): 50% common, 33% uncommon, 17% rare (act 4: 0/100/0). 'screenless' relics reroll BOTTLED_FLAME/BOTTLED_LIGHTNING/BOTTLED_TORNADO/WHETSTONE.
spire-archive choice lists include post-outcome UI buttons ([Continue]/[Leave]) that are not real decisions; these are omitted here and not flagged as conflicts.
Event selection: eventRng rolls shrine-vs-event (SHRINE_CHANCE=0.25); chosen event is removed from its pool. canSpawn preconditions per GameContext.cpp canAddEvent/canAddOneTimeEvent.
Neow is covered by the meta corpus, not this file.
meta.a15PoolChange: NOTE_FOR_YOURSELF is absent from the one-time pool at ascension >= 15 (Events.h oneTimeEventsAsc15).

LAGAVULIN_EVENT.note: Lagavulin variant that starts awake (no sleep phase).

COLOSSEUM_EVENT_SLAVERS.note: Blue Slaver + Red Slaver; fight yields no rewards.

COLOSSEUM_EVENT_NOBS.note: Taskmaster + Gremlin Nob; treated as elite combat for most effects, but Black Star does not add a second relic.

MYSTERIOUS_SPHERE_EVENT.note: 2 Orb Walkers; not an elite combat for relic triggers.
